name: ManagePilot Multisite Toolkit
author: WP Plugin Pilot

sections.description:
ManagePilot Multisite Toolkit is a professional-grade network administration plugin built specifically for WordPress Multisite environments.

Instead of switching between individual site dashboards, ManagePilot provides a centralized control center where administrators can manage content, plugins, themes, users, and settings across multiple sites from one clean interface.

Designed for agencies, developers, SaaS operators, e-commerce businesses, and enterprise multisite owners, the plugin focuses on speed, scalability, usability, and workflow efficiency.

Why Use ManagePilot?

Managing dozens or hundreds of WordPress sites manually wastes time and increases operational complexity. ManagePilot simplifies multisite administration by providing bulk management tools and network-wide automation features inside a modern interface.

Whether you’re publishing content across sites, deploying plugins, assigning users, or monitoring site health, ManagePilot helps reduce repetitive work and improve productivity.

Core Features

  • Centralized Multisite Dashboard
    Manage your entire WordPress Multisite network from one streamlined admin panel.

  • Content Builder
    Create and publish posts or pages across multiple selected sites simultaneously.

  • Featured Image Support
    Upload and assign featured images during bulk content publishing workflows.

  • Plugin Manager
    Bulk activate or deactivate plugins across selected network sites.

  • Theme Switcher
    Deploy and switch themes network-wide with a single action.

  • Global User Management
    Create users globally and automatically assign roles to multiple sites.

  • Global Settings Management
    Update site taglines, visibility, discussion settings, and permalink structures across your network.

  • Live Site Monitoring
    Monitor HTTP status and SSL validation for all sites in real time.

  • Performance Focused
    Optimized for large multisite environments with scalable workflows.

  • Minimalist Industrial Interface
    A modern, distraction-free UI focused on productivity and efficiency.

Built For

  • WordPress agencies
  • Developers managing client networks
  • E-commerce multisite operators
  • SaaS businesses
  • Educational institutions
  • Enterprise multisite infrastructures
sections.installation:
1. Upload the managepilot-multisite-toolkit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Network Admin Plugins screen.
  3. Ensure WordPress Multisite is enabled on your installation.
  4. Navigate to:
    Network Admin > Dashboard > ManagePilot Toolkit
  5. Start managing your network from a single dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work on single-site WordPress installations?

No. ManagePilot Multisite Toolkit is designed exclusively for WordPress Multisite environments.

Is the plugin compatible with large multisite networks?

Yes. The plugin is optimized for scalability and can handle large networks efficiently. For best performance, extremely large operations should be processed in batches.

Will changing permalink structures break my sites?

No. The plugin automatically flushes rewrite rules after updating permalink settings to ensure URLs continue functioning correctly.

Can I bulk manage plugins and themes?

Yes. You can activate, deactivate, and deploy plugins or themes across selected sites from a centralized interface.

Does the plugin monitor SSL certificates?

Yes. ManagePilot includes live SSL verification and HTTP health monitoring for network sites.

Is the plugin developer friendly?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress coding standards and is structured for extensibility and maintainability.
